extracted text: The composition of the alloys is provided in atomic percent in Table I. Table II provides mechanical properties including ultimate tensile strength (UTS), yield stress (YS), Vickers hardness (HV), and elongation percentage. The T6 temper carried out for the Al 7075 alloy involved solution treating at 465°C for 30 minutes, followed by rapid quenching in water and finally age hardening at 135°C for 14 hours. The T6 temper for the Al 2024 alloy involved solution treating at 490°C for 30 minutes, followed by rapid quenching in water and finally age hardening at 160°C for 6 hours. H24 temper refers to work hardening followed by partial annealing (240°C).
